title: Maximum Product Subarray
keyIdea: Keep both the largest and the smallest product of a subarray ending at i. A negative number swaps their roles, so swap them first; then curMax = max(x, curMax × x), curMin = min(x, curMin × x). The answer is the best curMax.

approaches.name: Max and min ending here
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). If x < 0 swap curMax and curMin; curMax = max(x, curMax × x); curMin = min(x, curMin × x); best = max(best, curMax).

quiz.q: Why isn't tracking only the max enough (unlike Kadane's)?
options: A very negative product becomes the largest after another negative
Both become 0, so the next subarray starts fresh
